MANDARIN — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #2
====

GRADE: Grade 9
SUBJECT: MANDARIN
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 100
EXAM BODY: KJSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. When practising Interactive Speaking, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Interactive Speaking.
   B. Copy random text without understanding Interactive Speaking.
   C. Avoid reading anything related to Interactive Speaking.
   D. Use insults to “practise” Interactive Speaking.

2. When practising Active Listening, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Active Listening.
   B. Use insults to “practise” Active Listening.
   C. Copy random text without understanding Active Listening.
   D. Avoid reading anything related to Active Listening.

3. In MANDARIN, the best classroom habit is: (1 mark)
   A. Only memorise without using the language
   B. Practise listening, speaking, reading, and writing every day
   C. Mix random languages with no purpose
   D. Avoid speaking to classmates

4. When practising Oral Expression, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Oral Expression.
   B. Avoid reading anything related to Oral Expression.
   C. Copy random text without understanding Oral Expression.
   D. Use insults to “practise” Oral Expression.

5. When practising Reading for Information, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use insults to “practise” Reading for Information.
   B. Copy random text without understanding Reading for Information.
   C. Avoid reading anything related to Reading for Information.
   D. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Reading for Information.

6. When practising Phonological Awareness, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Phonological Awareness.
   B. Copy random text without understanding Phonological Awareness.
   C. Avoid reading anything related to Phonological Awareness.
   D. Use insults to “practise” Phonological Awareness.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
7. In three clear sentences, explain Interactive Speaking and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

8. In three clear sentences, explain Phonological Awareness and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

9. In three clear sentences, explain Oral Expression and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

10. In three clear sentences, explain Interactive Speaking and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

11. In three clear sentences, explain Oral Expression and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

12. In three clear sentences, explain Oral Expression and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

13. In three clear sentences, explain Oral Expression and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Active Listening and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Reading for Information and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Reading for Fluency and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
